links.outcome: Comparative accuracy, comprehensiveness, and safety of two LLMs on same cardiovascular cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o outperformed Kimi on treatment accuracy (P=0.004) and comprehensiveness (P<0.001); high-risk outputs 1.5% vs 4.5%; diagnostic accuracy similar (P=0.663).
links.quote: For treatment recommendations, ChatGPT-4o outperformed Kimi in both accuracy (P = 0.004, r = 0.321) and comprehensiveness (P < 0.001, r = 0.644).

screen.reason: The study is a comparative evaluation of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and Kimi) on 200 published complex cardiovascular case reports, assessed by expert clinicians. It evaluates model accuracy, comprehensiveness, and safety risk but does not test a deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
